arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import parse
# Test precision_fail case
print('Precision fail:', parse.parse('Pi/10 = {:8.5f}', 'Pi/10 = .31415'))
# Test normal cases
print('Normal 0.31415:', parse.parse('Pi/10 = {:8.5f}', 'Pi/10 =  0.31415'))
print('Plain f:', parse.parse('{:f}', '12.0'))
print('Sign +:', parse.parse('{:f}', '+12.1'))
print('Sign -:', parse.parse('{:f}', '-12.1'))
" 2>&1 | grep -E '(Precision|Normal|Plain|Sign)'
